scope: C++ design probes only; Rust NATURAL/USING implementation and parity are not established. No timings.

results.name: merged_and_qualified_keys
results.sql: SELECT k,a.k,b.k FROM (VALUES (1),(2),(NULL))a(k) FULL JOIN (VALUES(2),(3),(NULL))b(k) USING(k) ORDER BY 1 NULLS LAST,2 NULLS LAST,3 NULLS LAST

results.name: star_order
results.sql: SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('left',1,9))a(v,k,z) JOIN (VALUES(1,'right'))b(k,w) USING(k)

results.name: qualified_stars
results.sql: SELECT a.*,b.* FROM (VALUES(1,'left'))a(k,v) FULL JOIN (VALUES(2,'right'))b(k,w) USING(k) ORDER BY coalesce(a.k,b.k)

results.name: coalesced_key_types
results.sql: SELECT typeof(k),typeof(a.k),typeof(b.k) FROM (VALUES(1::INTEGER))a(k) FULL JOIN (VALUES(2::BIGINT))b(k) USING(k) ORDER BY k

results.name: left_key_types
results.sql: SELECT typeof(k),typeof(a.k),typeof(b.k) FROM (VALUES(1::INTEGER))a(k) LEFT JOIN (VALUES(1::BIGINT))b(k) USING(k)

results.name: right_key_types
results.sql: SELECT typeof(k),typeof(a.k),typeof(b.k) FROM (VALUES(1::INTEGER))a(k) RIGHT JOIN (VALUES(1::BIGINT))b(k) USING(k)

results.name: chained_full
results.sql: SELECT k,a.k,b.k,c.k FROM (VALUES(1))a(k) FULL JOIN (VALUES(2))b(k) USING(k) FULL JOIN (VALUES(2),(3))c(k) USING(k) ORDER BY k

results.name: duplicate_using_names
results.sql: SELECT * FROM (VALUES(1))a(k) JOIN (VALUES(1))b(k) USING(k,k)

results.name: natural_no_common
results.sql: SELECT * FROM (VALUES(1))a(x) NATURAL JOIN (VALUES(1))b(y)
results.stderr:

   Right candidates: b.y

results.name: aliased_join

Candidate tables: "a"
